description_en: Queries details of on-premises gateway images, including their names and descriptions
description_zh: 查询线下网关镜像信息。包括线下网关镜像的名称、描述等
name: DescribeGatewayImages

parameters.help_en:
The type of the gateway. Valid values:

File: file gateway.
Iscsi: iSCSI gateway
parameters.help_zh:
网关类型。取值范围：

File：文件网关。

Iscsi：块网关
parameters.name: type

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

Image.description_en: The information about the on-premises gateway images

items.description_en: The information about the on-premises gateway image

Description.description_en:
The description of the image. Possible values:

sgw.file.ova.description: Use this OVA image to install the cloud storage file gateway service on VMware vSphere 6.0 or later.
sgw.file.vhd.description: Use this VHD image to install the cloud storage file gateway service on Microsoft Hyper-V.
sgw.file.kvm.description: Use this qcow2 image to install the cloud storage file gateway service on KVM
Description.description_zh:
镜像描述。可能值：

sgw.file.ova.description：用这个ova镜像在VMWare vSphere（支持6.0版本及以上）上安装云存储文件网关服务。

sgw.file.vhd.description：用这个vhd镜像在Microsoft HyperV上安装云存储文件网关服务。

sgw.file.kvm.description：用这个qcow2镜像在KVM上安装云存储文件网关服务

MD5.description_en: The MD5 hash of the on-premises gateway image file

ModifiedDate.description_en: The date when the image was last modified

Size.description_en: The size of the image. Unit: bytes

Title.description_en:
The i18n key for the name of the on-premises gateway image. Possible values:

sgw.file.ova.title: Performance-optimized cloud storage file gateway image for VMware vSphere 6.0 or later.
sgw.file.vhd.title: Performance-optimized cloud storage file gateway image for Microsoft Hyper-V.
sgw.file.kvm.title: Performance-optimized cloud storage file gateway image for KVM
Title.description_zh:
线下网关镜像名字的i18n key。可能值：

sgw.file.ova.title：云存储性能型文件网关 vSphere（v6.0及以上）镜像。

sgw.file.vhd.title：云存储性能型文件网关HyperV镜像。

sgw.file.kvm.title：云存储性能型文件网关KVM镜像

Url.description_en: The download URL of the on-premises gateway. The URL is valid for one hour
Url.description_zh: 线下网关的下载地址。有效时间为1小时

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
